remarks: Located one mile from New Canaan's town center, 377 Main Street, Unit 17 offers turnkey townhouse living just moments from Metro-North, Waveny Park and New Canaan schools. This light-filled condominium blends low-maintenance living with the privacy and scale of a single-family home. Featuring 3 bedrooms with cathedral ceilings, 2.5 baths, and approximately 2,800 square feet - including a finished lower level - this Kings Grant residence offers expansive living areas, hardwood floors throughout, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Elevated, private positioning within the complex and oversized windows provide exceptional natural light and peaceful views. The spacious kitchen includes a center island, stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and sliding doors opening to a sun-filled deck - ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Additional highlights include a wood-burning fireplace, natural gas, direct access to a private terrace and two elevated decks, abundant storage, and an attached two-car garage. Kings Grant is a pet-friendly community featuring a beautifully maintained, heated pool and professionally managed grounds.
